subject: Latest report and Jordan's new batch
body:
Hey team,

Here's the latest performance report
https://docs.google.com/document/d/17wPfuA2G0hpMCbzsxpToIpJp1JSqlaga/edit?usp=sharing

We generated 221 enquiries from A$1,197.74 across Victoria and Queensland, at A$5.42 each, with 78 completed applications.

Jordan's new batch is doing the heavy lifting. The videos spent A$428.43 for 90 enquiries at A$4.76 each, the statics spent A$149.39 for 24 enquiries at A$6.22 each. Together that's 48% of the spend and 114 of the 221 enquiries.

Darren mentioned a lot of the people enquiring are renting. Worth adding home owners to the messaging as well?

Cheers
William
source: Meta Graph v22.0 ad-level insights (same pull as the report) + Will's instruction on Darren's renter/home-owner feedback
draft: local only (gmail.compose not delegated to the service account)
superseded_intermediate: an earlier revision in this session quoted A$1,197.75 (ad-level sum); the final draft quotes the report's A$1,197.74
